name: Mozambik Wilderness
description_short: Portuguese-inspired flame-grilled seafood and peri-peri chicken in a lively, family-friendly atmosphere along the Garden Route.
description_long:
Mozambik Wilderness brings the vibrant flavours of Portuguese East Africa to the Garden Route, serving their signature flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, prawns, and espetadas in a relaxed, colourful setting. The menu showcases generous platters perfect for sharing, with options ranging from their famous Trinchado to catch-of-the-day seafood, all prepared with their distinctive spice blends and marinades.

The atmosphere strikes a balance between casual dining and celebration-worthy meals, with attentive service that keeps families, groups, and couples comfortable. Located on George Road in Wilderness, it's an easy stop whether you're heading to the beach or exploring the Garden Route. The consistent quality and portion sizes have earned it a loyal following among locals and visitors alike.

Expect bold flavours, lively energy, and that distinctive Mozambik warmth that's made this small chain a South African favourite. Their outdoor seating area adds to the relaxed coastal vibe, while the indoor space handles the occasional rainy day with equal charm.
